fusions.name: Drilled Feint
fusions.desc: A feint and strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and has a 50% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Flawless Misdirection
fusions.desc: A rehearsed flourish that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and each enemy struck has a 40% chance to be turned against its allies for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Trick Up the Sleeve
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and slips you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Warmed-Up Routine
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (16% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
